base_url.description: Protocol and host of the EasyVista Service Manager server, without path (e.g. https://company.easyvista.com)

tenant_id.description: EasyVista account number used in the API URL (e.g. 50004)

use_token.description: Authenticate with an access token (Bearer); otherwise with the login and password of a REST API user (Basic)

username.description: Login of the REST API user. Required when use_token is false

password.description: Password of the REST API user. Required when use_token is false

token.description: Access token of the EasyVista Service Manager REST API. Required when use_token is true

verify_ssl.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the server

description: EasyVista Service Manager is an IT service management (ITSM) platform that manages the IT assets of an organization.
name: EasyVista Service Manager
